meta.title: 骗了摄影圈上百年的蝴蝶光
meta.title_en: The Butterfly Light That Fooled Photographers for a Century

scenes.title_cn: 开场：揭穿一个骗了99%摄影师的骗局…
scenes.title_en: Opening: Let me expose a myth that has foo…
scenes.context: 博主质疑把鼻子下方的蝴蝶形阴影当作蝴蝶光的刻板认知。
sentences: 来跟大家揭穿一个骗了99%摄影师的骗局。
Let me expose a myth that has fooled 99% of photographers.
Challenge the common belief.
鼻子下面有蝴蝶叫蝴蝶光，你看见鼻子下的蝴蝶了吗？
People call it butterfly light when there's a butterfly under the nose—do you actually see one?
The 'butterfly' is the nose shadow.
scenes.speak: Let me expose a myth that has fooled 99% of photographers. People call it butterfly light when there's a butterfly under the nose—do you actually see one?

scenes.title_cn: 找光影的错误逻辑：一说伦勃朗光就只在…
scenes.title_en: The wrong logic: people look only for a br…
scenes.context: 学习布光不应只找结果特征，而应理解光的动机。
sentences: 一说伦勃朗光，你非得在脸颊上找亮区。
Mention Rembrandt light and you insist on finding a bright patch on the cheek.
Stop looking for results only.
对摄影的光影，你理解得太到位了。
You sure have a deep understanding of photographic lighting.
Sarcasm: it's actually shallow.
scenes.speak: Mention Rembrandt light and you insist on finding a bright patch on the cheek. You sure have a deep understanding of photographic lighting.

scenes.title_cn: 蝴蝶光的真正来历：源自上世纪20年代…
scenes.title_en: The real origin: it comes from 1920s Holly…
scenes.context: 蝴蝶光也叫派拉蒙光，因派拉蒙影业而闻名。
sentences: 蝴蝶光又叫派拉蒙光，上世纪20年代好莱坞有一家电影公司叫派拉蒙。
Butterfly light is also called Paramount light—1920s Hollywood had a studio called Paramount.
Know the real origin.
他们用这种布光形式来拍明星照，用于电影海报。
They used this lighting for star portraits and movie posters.
Hollywood's golden-era look.
格蕾塔·嘉宝、玛丽·莲梦露、奥黛丽·赫本，谁没拍过派拉蒙光。
Greta Garbo, Marilyn Monroe, Audrey Hepburn—who hasn't shot in Paramount light?
Legends all shot this way.
scenes.speak: Butterfly light is also called Paramount light—1920s Hollywood had a studio called Paramount. They used this lighting for star portraits and movie posters. Greta Garbo, Marilyn Monroe, Audrey Hepburn—who hasn't shot in Paramount light?

scenes.title_cn: 学习布光要找动机：打三角形亮区或鼻子…
scenes.title_en: Learn the motive: creating a triangle high…
scenes.context: 布光的目的是表现立体感，而不是制造某个形状。
sentences: 我们学布光，本末倒置，找三角形亮光也好，找鼻子下面蝴蝶也好，都是在找结果。
When we learn lighting backward, whether finding the triangle highlight or the nose butterfly, we're only chasing results.
Don't chase results, chase intent.
做任何事情都有个目的，叫做动机。
Everything you do has a purpose—that's the motive.
Ask why, not what.
打三角形亮区是你的目的吗？显然不是。
Is creating a triangle highlight your goal? Clearly not.
The shape is a side effect.
scenes.speak: When we learn lighting backward, whether finding the triangle highlight or the nose butterfly, we're only chasing results. Everything you do has a purpose—that's the motive. Is creating a triangle highlight your goal? Clearly not.

scenes.title_cn: 蝴蝶光的正确打法：用雷达罩，光心对准…
scenes.title_en: The correct setup: use a beauty dish, aim …
scenes.context: 关键参数：雷达罩、鼻梁对准、额头高度、伸手距离。
sentences: 蝴蝶光的打法是用雷达罩，光的中心轴对准鼻梁。
For butterfly light, use a beauty dish and aim the center of light at the bridge of the nose.
Beauty dish is the tool.
平齐额头的高度，光的位置大概伸手的摸着。
Level with the forehead, positioned about an arm's reach away.
Remember this key point.
scenes.speak: For butterfly light, use a beauty dish and aim the center of light at the bridge of the nose. Level with the forehead, positioned about an arm's reach away.

scenes.title_cn: 雷达罩的特点：中间有块反射板挡住中心…
scenes.title_en: The beauty dish feature: a center reflecto…
scenes.context: 正因为中心光被挡，光线向鼻梁两边暗下去，形成立体感。
sentences: 雷达罩中间有一块反射板，挡住中心亮区。
A beauty dish has a center reflector that blocks the bright core.
The dish's key design.
形成了一个像日全食一样的亮环，边缘慢慢的衰减下去。
It forms a ring like a total solar eclipse, with edges fading gradually.
Soft, even falloff.
scenes.speak: A beauty dish has a center reflector that blocks the bright core. It forms a ring like a total solar eclipse, with edges fading gradually.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么脸上出现蝴蝶：眼睛下方的肌肉微…
scenes.title_en: Why the butterfly appears: the muscle unde…
scenes.context: 蝴蝶是面部结构在特定光位下的自然结果。
sentences: 你觉得这块肌肉是垂直地面长，还是跟鼻梁一样微微的朝上长？
Is this muscle vertical to the ground, or does it tilt slightly upward like the bridge of the nose?
Feel it with your fingers.
是不是刚好垂直雷达照？整张脸受光最多的就是这里。
Isn't it directly facing the dish? This is where the face receives the most light.
The brightest zones form the butterfly.
这块肌肉叫口轮匝肌，是一个圆环状的肌肉。
This muscle is the orbicularis oris, a ring-shaped muscle.
Anatomy shapes the light pattern.
scenes.speak: Is this muscle vertical to the ground, or does it tilt slightly upward like the bridge of the nose? Isn't it directly facing the dish? This is where the face receives the most light. This muscle is the orbicularis oris, a ring-shaped muscle.

scenes.title_cn: 蝴蝶光的真正目的：和化妆一样，在鼻梁…
scenes.title_en: The real purpose: just like makeup—darkeni…
scenes.context: 拍蝴蝶光是为了立体感，不是为了拍出蝴蝶。
sentences: 你们化妆的时候是不是在这里画高光？在鼻梁两侧和颧骨以外压暗的粉底。
When you do makeup, don't you highlight here, and use darker foundation beside the nose and outside the cheekbones?
Makeup teaches lighting.
蝴蝶光的目的就是拍出立体感，而不是为了拍出蝴蝶。
The purpose of butterfly light is dimension, not a butterfly shape.
The butterfly is a byproduct.
scenes.speak: When you do makeup, don't you highlight here, and use darker foundation beside the nose and outside the cheekbones? The purpose of butterfly light is dimension, not a butterfly shape.

scenes.title_cn: 破除亚洲人不适合蝴蝶光的说法：把灯太…
scenes.title_en: Busting the myth that Asian faces don't su…
scenes.context: 用现实检验证明：强行找蝴蝶反而失去美感。
sentences: 有一种说法，说亚洲人的五官长得不够立体，不适合拍蝴蝶光。
Some say Asian features aren't defined enough for butterfly light.
The myth to be busted.
有了蝴蝶吧，但是你有没有看见整张脸像一个倒三角形的骷髅脸，完全没有了美感。
Now there's a butterfly, but don't you see the whole face like an inverted-triangle skull, with no beauty at all?
Forcing it ruins the portrait.
他们的逻辑还是在找蝴蝶，没有蝴蝶就不是蝴蝶光。
Their logic still hunts for the butterfly—no butterfly, no butterfly light.
That's the fundamental mistake.
scenes.speak: Some say Asian features aren't defined enough for butterfly light. Now there's a butterfly, but don't you see the whole face like an inverted-triangle skull, with no beauty at all? Their logic still hunts for the butterfly—no butterfly, no butterfly light.

practice: Butterfly light is also called Paramount light.
Aim the beauty dish center at the bridge of the nose.
The muscle under the eye faces the dish directly.
The goal is dimension, not a butterfly shape.
pitfalls: Hunt for the butterfly shadow under the nose.
Learn the motive behind the lighting.
找结果不如找动机，蝴蝶只是副产品。
Raise the light until the butterfly appears.
Keep the dish at forehead height and arm's reach.
强行找蝴蝶会让脸变成骷髅脸，正确参数是额头高、一臂距。
Say Asian faces don't suit butterfly light.
The myth fails: forcing the butterfly ruins beauty.
亚洲人不适合蝴蝶光是对「找蝴蝶」逻辑的误读。
Judge the light by the triangle shape only.
Judge it by dimension and three-dimensionality.
判断标准是立体感而不是某个形状。
shifts: 用 beauty dish（雷达罩）、light ring（亮环）、falloff（衰减）
用 motive（动机）、dimension（立体感）、byproduct（副产品）
用 orbicularis muscle（口轮匝肌）、eyebrow bone（眉弓骨）、cheekbone（颧骨）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：派拉蒙光、雷达罩、反射板、日全食亮环、口轮匝肌、眉弓骨、颧骨、立体感、骷髅脸、亚洲人不适合蝴蝶光的破除等。
